hunks.baseline: The smell of mold stabbed at my nose as soon as I entered the room. The place reminded me of a military barracks, and the members of the reconnaissance squad were waiting inside.
hunks.sol: The smell of mold hit me the moment I stepped into the room. The place reminded me of a military barracks, and the members of the reconnaissance squad were waiting inside.

hunks.baseline: I sharpened my senses and looked over each of them.
hunks.sol: I sharpened my senses and looked them over one by one.

hunks.baseline: Every time my gaze passed over an unfamiliar face, a Level display popped up.
hunks.sol: Each time my gaze passed over an unfamiliar face, a Level display popped up.

hunks.baseline: Most of them were around the same level. Then, as I moved on to the ninth person—
hunks.sol: Most of them were around the same level. Then I reached the ninth man—

hunks.baseline: It was the same Hyuk Mujin who had picked a fight with me when I first arrived at the Jin Family of Taiyuan a few days ago. When our eyes met, he smirked.
hunks.sol: It was the same Hyuk Mujin who had picked a fight with me when I first arrived at the Jin Family of Taiyuan a few days ago. When our eyes met, he curled his lips into a smirk.

hunks.baseline: I stared at his openly hostile smile and said,
hunks.sol: I stared at his openly hostile smile.

hunks.baseline: “……As you wish.”
hunks.sol: “…As you wish.”

hunks.baseline: I ignored Hyuk Mujin’s piercing stare and looked at the tenth member of the reconnaissance squad. The young man who had been smiling brightly since I first appeared shot to his feet.
hunks.sol: Ignoring Hyuk Mujin’s piercing stare, I turned to the tenth member of the reconnaissance squad. The young man who had been beaming ever since I walked in shot to his feet.

hunks.baseline: It seemed some assignments had been changed because of the war. The White Tiger Hall clerk I had met earlier said that the reconnaissance squad itself was made up of martial artists drawn from several different places.
hunks.sol: It seemed some assignments had been changed because of the war. The White Tiger Hall clerk I had met earlier said the reconnaissance squad was made up of martial artists drawn from several different units.

hunks.baseline: Maybe that was why the atmosphere in the room was so disorganized.
hunks.sol: Maybe that was why the atmosphere in the room felt so unsettled.

hunks.baseline: The squad members looked at me with expressions that mixed the awkwardness of strangers meeting for the first time with anxiety and anticipation about the war.
hunks.sol: The squad members watched me with expressions that mixed the awkwardness of strangers with anxiety and anticipation about the war.

hunks.baseline: “I’m Jin Taekyung, appointed leader of White Tiger Hall’s reconnaissance squad. I look forward to working with you.”
hunks.sol: “I’m Jin Taekyung, the newly appointed leader of White Tiger Hall’s reconnaissance squad. I look forward to working with you.”

hunks.baseline: Someone’s lonely applause died out within a few seconds, and Han Yeop lowered his hand with an embarrassed expression.
hunks.sol: The lonely applause died after only a few seconds, and Han Yeop lowered his hands, looking embarrassed.

hunks.baseline: We were in wartime. Maintaining the current tension was better than laughing together and trying to socialize.
hunks.sol: We were at war. Better to keep them on edge than have everyone laughing and trying to make friends.

hunks.baseline: Of course, too much tension could become poisonous. Easing it at the right moment was one of my duties as squad leader.
hunks.sol: Of course, too much tension could do more harm than good. Easing it at the right moment was one of my responsibilities as squad leader.

hunks.baseline: Newbie Hunters froze the moment they entered a Gate for the first time. Real combat was different from practice. Everything they had learned and trained for at the Hunter training center flew off into outer space, and they were overwhelmed by the primal scent of death.
hunks.sol: Newbie Hunters froze the moment they entered a Gate for the first time. Real combat was nothing like practice. Everything they had learned at the Hunter training center flew straight out of their heads, and the primal scent of death overwhelmed them.

hunks.baseline: That was why veterans in the Guild handled mental care for the rookies. I had been one of them.
hunks.sol: That was why Guild veterans helped the rookies keep their heads. I had been one of them.

hunks.baseline: *Though I was assigned exclusively to F-ranks.*
hunks.sol: *Though I only handled F-ranks.*

hunks.baseline: The levels were similar, too. From what I could tell, a second-rate martial artist from Murim was somewhere between an E-rank and an F-rank.
hunks.sol: Their abilities were similar, too. From what I could tell, a second-rate martial artist in Murim fell somewhere between an E-rank and an F-rank.

hunks.baseline: In other words, I had become the leader of a ten-person F-rank party. I had never actually been a party leader, but I had watched what they were supposed to do until I was sick of it.
hunks.sol: In other words, I had become the leader of a ten-person F-rank party. I had never actually been a party leader before, but I had watched other people do the job until I was sick of it.

hunks.baseline: At my abrupt question, every member of the reconnaissance squad raised a hand. They all looked bewildered.
hunks.sol: At the abrupt question, every member of the reconnaissance squad raised a hand. They all looked bewildered.

hunks.baseline: “Raise your hand if you’ve been in combat at least five times.”
hunks.sol: “Keep it raised if you’ve fought at least five times.”

hunks.baseline: Half the hands went down. Han Yeop was among them.
hunks.sol: Half the hands went down. Han Yeop’s was among them.

hunks.baseline: Five people with experience in at least five battles. That wasn’t bad. No, it was better than expected.
hunks.sol: Five people with experience in at least five battles. That wasn’t bad. In fact, it was better than expected.

hunks.baseline: “Raise your hand if you’ve killed someone.”
hunks.sol: “Keep it raised if you’ve killed someone.”

hunks.baseline: Four hands dropped weakly. I looked at the only member of the reconnaissance squad who still had his hand raised.
hunks.sol: Four hands slowly fell. I looked at the only member of the reconnaissance squad whose hand was still raised.

hunks.baseline: “Five. It was during last year’s bandit suppression campaign. One of them was a bandit chieftain. He was quite a strong bastard—”
hunks.sol: “Five. During last year’s bandit suppression campaign. One of them was a deputy stronghold chief, and he was quite a strong bastard—”

hunks.baseline: I cut him off before he could continue.
hunks.sol: I cut him off.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin’s mouth, which had been preparing to ramble on, snapped shut.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin’s mouth snapped shut mid-boast.

hunks.baseline: “Yeah. Speak up now if you don’t like it.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. Speak up now if you don’t want the job.”

hunks.baseline: White cat, black cat, or even a rude cat—it didn’t matter as long as it caught mice.
hunks.sol: White, black, or downright obnoxious—it didn’t matter as long as the cat caught mice.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin thought for a while with a complicated expression before answering.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin considered it with a complicated look before answering.

hunks.baseline: “……Hmph. Since it’s an order, I suppose it can’t be helped.”
hunks.sol: “…Hmph. Since it’s an order, I suppose it can’t be helped.”

hunks.baseline: “Then Hyuk Mujin is deputy squad leader. From now on, we’ll call you Number One.”
hunks.sol: “Then Hyuk Mujin is the deputy squad leader. From now on, we’ll call you Number One.”

hunks.baseline: “Number order. From now on, the reconnaissance squad will be referred to by number instead of name. Hyuk Mujin is Number One. Next, you sitting over there. Yes, you’re Number Two.”
hunks.sol: “It’s your number. From now on, everyone in the reconnaissance squad goes by a number instead of a name. Hyuk Mujin is Number One. Next, you sitting over there. Yes, you’re Number Two.”

hunks.baseline: I finished assigning numbers one by one, from Number One to Number Ten.
hunks.sol: I pointed them out one by one until I had assigned Numbers One through Ten.

hunks.baseline: “Why are you doing this?”
hunks.sol: “Why are we doing that?”

hunks.baseline: “It’s more convenient. We might be fighting today. Do you want to spend all day memorizing names?”
hunks.sol: “Because it’s easier. We could end up fighting today. Do you want me to spend all day memorizing names?”

hunks.baseline: I didn’t look away from Hyuk Mujin as he glared at me with a hard expression.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin glared at me, his face rigid, but I didn’t look away.

hunks.baseline: Part of me even hoped he would act insolent like he had that day. A battle could break out within the next few days. If things continued as they were, that would be a problem.
hunks.sol: Part of me even hoped he would get cocky like he had that day. A battle could break out within the next few days, and I couldn’t have him acting like this when it did.

hunks.baseline: “……I will follow your orders.”
hunks.sol: “…I’ll follow your orders.”

hunks.baseline: “Number One. I said Number One.”
hunks.sol: “Number One. I said I’m Number One.”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin’s voice trembled as he answered. He was more perceptive than I had expected. Maybe it was because of the rumors about the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin’s voice trembled. He was more perceptive than I had expected. Maybe it was because of the rumors about the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi.

hunks.baseline: The important thing was that Hyuk Mujin had submitted to me.
hunks.sol: What mattered was that he had accepted my authority.

hunks.baseline: Without showing anything on my face, I continued.
hunks.sol: Without letting anything show on my face, I continued.

hunks.baseline: “What I’m about to say may sound strange and unfamiliar. But bear with it. It’s better than getting stabbed to death, isn’t it? Don’t you agree?”
hunks.sol: “What I’m about to say may sound strange. But bear with it. That’s better than getting stabbed to death, isn’t it?”

hunks.baseline: The other reconnaissance squad members didn’t show their displeasure as openly as Hyuk Mujin, but they also looked at me anxiously.
hunks.sol: The other squad members didn’t show their displeasure as openly as Hyuk Mujin, but they still looked at me uneasily.

hunks.baseline: “I’ll follow whatever the Squad Leader says!”
hunks.sol: “I’ll do whatever the Squad Leader says!”

hunks.baseline: Han Yeop shouted like a teenage girl idol fan. The only difference was that he was holding a spear instead of an idol light stick.
hunks.sol: Han Yeop shouted like a fangirl. The only difference was that he was holding a spear instead of an idol light stick.

hunks.baseline: The core of party hunting was dividing up positions.
hunks.sol: The key to party hunting was assigning positions.

hunks.baseline: *Of course, there are no mages or healers.*
hunks.sol: *Of course, there are no mages or healers here.*

hunks.baseline: I had to balance things as much as possible with tanks and damage dealers alone, but—
hunks.sol: I had to balance the party as best I could using only tanks and damage dealers, but—

hunks.baseline: “……You’re telling me no one knows how to use a shield?”
hunks.sol: “…You’re telling me no one knows how to use a shield?”

hunks.baseline: My voice trembled at the shocking result. Good lord, there were ten damage dealers. Nine used swords, and the only person with a spear was Han Yeop.
hunks.sol: My voice trembled at the shocking result. Good lord, all ten of them were damage dealers. Nine used swords, and Han Yeop was the only one with a spear.

hunks.baseline: A hybrid would be better. At least that would mean something had been mixed in.
hunks.sol: A hybrid would be better. At least then there would be some variety.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin spoke with an expression that suggested he couldn’t understand what was wrong.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin spoke as though he couldn’t understand what the problem was.

hunks.baseline: I was speechless when I saw the others nodding along with him.
hunks.sol: Seeing the others nod along left me speechless.

hunks.baseline: *You’re too well-fed. Way too well-fed.*
hunks.sol: *They’ve had it way too easy. Way too easy.*

hunks.baseline: Try slamming your head into a pool of blood and see if you still talk like that.
hunks.sol: Let them stick their heads into a pool of blood and see if they could still say that.

hunks.baseline: Sword? Spear? There was no such distinction. You bashed people with whatever rock you happened to grab, threw dirt, climbed on top of them, and bit them with your teeth.
hunks.sol: Sword? Spear? There was no such distinction. You bashed people with whatever rock you happened to grab, threw dirt in their eyes, climbed on top of them, and bit them with your teeth.

hunks.baseline: On the line between life and death, anything in your hand was a weapon and a lifeline.
hunks.sol: When death was on the line, anything within reach became a weapon and a lifeline.

hunks.baseline: These people, who had only ever fought bandits at best, still didn’t understand that.
hunks.sol: These people had only ever fought bandits at best. They still didn’t understand that.

hunks.baseline: A large bell rang three times.
hunks.sol: A great bell tolled three times.

hunks.baseline: Since no one could tell the exact time, bells were rung at set intervals. The three tolls that had just sounded marked Mi-si, roughly one to three in the afternoon.[^1]
hunks.sol: Here, where no one had a way to know the exact time, bells were rung at set intervals throughout the day. The three tolls marked Mi-si, roughly one to three in the afternoon.[^1]

hunks.baseline: The bells also served as the signal announcing the reconnaissance squad’s first mission.
hunks.sol: They also signaled the reconnaissance squad’s first mission.

hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung looked up at Wipeng’s abrupt remark. Until a moment ago, he had been staring blankly at his cooling tea.

hunks.sol: A full day had passed since the reconnaissance squad led by Jin Taekyung left the Jin Family of Taiyuan. Their mission was to scout one of the county towns near the family estate.

hunks.sol: “…I’m beginning to doubt my ears.”

hunks.sol: “I agree to some extent. He’s changed considerably over the past few days.”

hunks.sol: “Anyway, I can stop worrying about the youngest now. I’ll be able to focus more on the family.”

hunks.sol: Wipeng fell silent at the sorrow and determination in his voice, and Jin Wikyung returned to his work.

hunks.sol: But the silence lasted only two hours.
